rationale: The plan correctly refuses to refit a count model, ranks every tested gene by the DESeq2 Wald statistic with an explicit duplicate rule and NA accounting (though no tie rule), and runs gseapy prerank against a local human Hallmark GMT with a 15-500 window, >=1000 permutations, seed 42, BH at 0.05, and NES/q/leading-edge output; the ORA-on-significant-genes path is explicitly forbidden. The MSigDB version is to be recorded at run time rather than named in the plan, and there is no sample-structure QC (PCA/library sizes) despite counts and metadata being available, with sample_01 handled only as a written caveat. The DE-model criteria (filter, normalization, formula, shrinkage) are largely moot for an enrichment-only task; the plan handles their consequences sensibly (reporting DESeq2 NA classes, stating the contrast direction, justifying Wald over unshrunken LFC) without over-claiming. The report specification is thorough and reproducible.
